_doc: The levels the picker offers, in order. 'map' is a town file (tools/make_town.py writes San Miguel's). With 'count', the gang is shuffled: that many bandits on the map's guard posts, the count itself the seed (the same count, the same town), the gang's mix kept from the map's own. Without it, the map's hand-placed gang. 'hidden' ones are for the tests. 'budget': the points the stranger spends on the loadout screen (guns and kit; 12 if none: a good gun in each slot and a bandage), by what the town asks of him: Paso Esperanza's open fight the most, Silencio's two gangs (tricks, not firepower) the fewest. 'dynamite': the sticks he has when a test skips the loadout screen. 'hanging': a man on the map's gallows, dropped 'at' seconds in unless the stranger stops it (see scripts/hanging.gd). 'captive': a man tied to a pole (its corner, tiles), stood over by the garrison man placed nearest 'guard', who counts 'count' seconds from the first shot before he shoots him (see scripts/captive.gd). 'stranger': his clothes for the level ({slot: [r, g, b]}, over enemies.json's player palette; painted by the shader, no re-bake). 'brief': what the stranger's told before he rides in: 'job', the level's goal in a plain line (the title card's and the Esc menu's), and 'cast', who he's up against on the title card ('%d' for how many; without it, so many bandits, or Silencio's two gangs).

arms._doc: Guns a wave can hand its men instead of their own ('arms' on a wave or one of its groups, by name; [] for their own): loadout options, as in enemies.json.

levels.name: San Miguel
levels.note: A gang holds the town, and a man hangs at noon.

brief.job: Kill the whole gang. They hang an innocent man at noon: save him if you can.

levels.name: San Miguel (waves)
levels.note: For testing: 20 bandits, then more down the roads every minute and a half.

levels.name: Cruz Verde
levels.note: A fort asleep, a prisoner at the well. They keep coming.

brief.job: Free the prisoner at the well, then hold the fort against every band. He will be executed if you are too slow.

levels.name: Paso Esperanza
levels.note: Hold off the army while the revolution loads the train.

brief.job: Protect the carriers until the train is unloaded, then leave on the last wagon. The federales want the guns back.

line.text: Pintamos de rojo sol y cielo

levels.name: Silencio
levels.note: Two gangs snowed in under a truce, and the outlaws' gold.

brief.job: Steal the outlaws' gold and carry it down to your horse, or kill both gangs. Turn them against each other.

levels.name: A Good Man Never Dies
levels.note: His own funeral. Everyone he crossed came to see it.

brief.job: Break out of your coffin before they bury you, then kill everyone who came to watch.

levels.name: Test yard
levels.note: A bare yard: no streets, townsfolk, reserve, boot hill or holdouts.
